desc:
Command infantry and lead your army to victory in large-scale battles featuring up to 1,600 soldiers.

Bot Commander is a tactical strategy game where you command infantry formations on the battlefield. Give your soldiers orders, manoeuvre your troops, coordinate attacks, capture objectives, and fight alongside your army.

⚔️ Command infantry formations
👥 Battles featuring up to 1,600 soldiers
🌍 Choose from 8 playable nations: France, Great Britain, Prussia, Russia, the Netherlands, Spain, Andour, and Freeguild
🗺️ Fight across Napoleonic battlefields
🏳️ Capture objectives and push back the enemy

Choose your nation, position your troops, and decide when to advance, fire, or hold your ground.

Updates every other Thursday. Check Settings -> Patch Notes for the latest changes.

Credits: Lurac_Case, Sylmat, StoolPigion, xqaidanxq, CodePrime8, PhilosopherKarlMarx, Valurim, DogenKaiser and Heyitzcold.
